parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are internally consistent with a plausible ATtiny fan controller: the power rails, ISP/I2C/fan/potentiometer interfaces, high-side P-FET switch, zener-clamped tach line, and passive values all match their roles. The two ATtiny symbols are pin-compatible alternate footprints (DIP ATtiny45 and SOIC ATtiny13) rather than a supported deviation.
